products.title: Carcass Halving Saw
products.html:
Abattoir Systems Carcass Halving Saw

The Slim Line carcass splitting saw offers more ergonomic and faster cutting thanks to its slimmed-down body. It is specially built with a 4 kW motor instead of 2 kW. In professional abattoir systems, its slim body makes splitting large cattle down the middle fast and practical. The redesigned special water spray system acts right at the cutting point. The dual trigger system and cover sensor allow the saw to be used only during cutting.

CARCASS SPLITTING SAW

The entire product is machined on a CNC machine. It operates balanced by a balancer, so the operator can work all day without strain. The abattoir work platform must be pneumatic and a leg spreading system must be present. Thanks to a blade only 0.5 mm thick, it cuts without damaging the carcass, and the water spray system prevents the carcass from discolouring due to heat.

Technical
Drive: Electric Motor power: 4 kW Operating voltage: 380 V 3-phase 50 Hz Capacity: 180 head/hour Blade length: 3200 mm Weight: 78 kg
products.seoDescription: Carcass Halving Saw with a 4 kW motor, 0.5 mm blade and water spray system. Capacity 180 head/hour, 3200 mm blade length, 78 kg. Slim Line model.

products.title: Qurbani Restraint Cabin
products.html:
Abattoir Systems Classic Slaughter Cell

Suitable for live animals of every size. Suitable for halal slaughter with a movable floor. Because it runs entirely on a pneumatic system, it works without problems in wet environments. It is a floor-mounted machine for the slaughter area of large cattle, whose three sides open and close by means of pneumatic cylinders, with a fixed barred front once the large animal has entered the cell. There are 2 pneumatic cylinders on the rear door, 2 pneumatic cylinders on the front door and 1 pneumatic cylinder on the guillotine door. It has no wheel system, which prevents faults such as doors dropping or coming off track. The product is made of galvanised steel.

SUITABLE FOR ANIMALS OF ANY SIZE

Suitable for large cattle of any size. Preferred for serial slaughter. The moving doors run on a special slide system that prevents wear and jerky movement. A double piston system for the front and rear doors is designed for balanced movement. The moving doors slide on 120x120x3 mm box profile over 100x100x3 mm box profile using polyethylene. The chassis is 100x100x3 mm stainless box profile. Cell platform 1000 x 2400 mm.
products.seoDescription: Qurbani Restraint Cabin: fully pneumatic, floor-mounted cell for large cattle with a movable floor, halal-suitable, galvanised steel, platform 1000 x 2400 mm.

products.title: Brisket Opening Saw
products.html:
BRISKET OPENING SAW

Technical Specifications

Used in abattoir systems to cut the front breastbones of large cattle. The saw is controlled by hand with the help of a balancer. It is mounted on the brisket opening station. The slaughterhouse operator starts cutting at a 45 degree angle with the cutting tip, which is designed not to damage the internal organs, and continues straight. The machine is made of stainless material and is high-performance. With the help of a balancer carrying its own weight, it can be used comfortably in the slaughterhouse.

Drive: Electric - Motor power: 2.2 kW - Operating voltage: 42-380 V 3-phase 50 Hz - Speed: 245 m/min - Blade length: 300 mm - Weight: 30 kg.
products.seoDescription: Brisket Opening Saw for cutting the breastbones of large cattle: 2.2 kW electric drive, 300 mm blade, balancer-assisted, stainless construction, 30 kg.

products.title: Standing Slaughter Cell
products.html:
Slaughter Cell with Neck Device

It is mounted on the floor at the slaughter area of large cattle, its three sides open and close by means of pneumatic cylinders, and once the large animal has entered the cell, its front is fitted with a neck stretching device. It has a bottom lifting mechanism, which allows the animal to be ejected after slaughter. There is 1 pneumatic cylinder on the rear pusher, 2 pneumatic cylinders on the front door, 1 pneumatic cylinder on the stretching mechanism and 2 pneumatic cylinders on the ejection door. The moving doors slide on 120x120x3 mm box profile over 100x100x2 mm box profile using polyethylene. The chassis is made of 80x80x3 and 100x100x2 mm stainless box profile. The fixed door side is made of 5 mm sheet and the moving door of 3 mm sheet. The lifting mechanism is made of 10 mm sheet. All of it will be 304-grade stainless.

Suitable for live animals of every size.

Overall dimensions are 2700x1000x2100 mm. For standing slaughter, it has a bottom lifting mechanism and a rear pusher arm. Suitable for halal slaughter. Because it runs entirely on a pneumatic system, it works without problems in wet environments.

  • Entirely 304-grade stainless.
  • Neck device.
  • Fast and practical.
  • Easy to use.
products.seoDescription: Standing Slaughter Cell with neck device: 304 stainless, pneumatic, bottom lifting mechanism and rear pusher, halal-suitable, dimensions 2700x1000x2100 mm.

products.title: Quartering Saw
products.html:
Quartering Saw

It cuts a carcass due to be split into 4 into four pieces as it arrives at the elevator, without taking it off the rail. It lowers slowly when passing from the high rail to the low rail.
It is driven by a 2.2 kW motor gearbox. It is used with two special gears and a special chain tensioning system. It runs quietly and smoothly. Thanks to the special chain used, no tensioning is required. It is also used to move carcasses arriving at the abattoir into the meat cold room.

Technical Specifications: 45 degree slope Entry level 4 m exit level 2.2 m - 2 kW motor gearbox - Chain and sprocket drive system - Twin rail and mono rail hook conveying system
products.seoDescription: Quartering Saw cuts carcasses into four pieces without taking them off the rail: 45 degree slope, 2.2 kW motor gearbox, chain drive, twin and mono rail hooks.

products.title: Saw Steriliser
products.html:
Saw Sterilisers

Cutting machines that may come into contact with a diseased animal, such as the carcass splitting saw, brisket opening saw and foot cutting shears, must be sterilised after every slaughter. For this purpose, after slaughter the saw is placed in the sterilising chamber and made ready for reuse with pressurised water and the steriliser.

CAN BE MOUNTED ON PLATFORMS

Since cutting machines in abattoir systems are generally used on a platform, the operator needs to carry out saw sterilisation on the spot. For this purpose, sterilisers need to be lightweight and compatible with the platform.
products.seoDescription: Saw Steriliser for carcass splitting saws, brisket saws and foot shears: sterilises with pressurised water after each slaughter, platform-mountable.

pages.title: About Us
pages.html:
Our project experts work on the design, manufacture and development of customer-specific Abattoir and Meat Processing Systems.

Facilities set up and commissioned by our expert team across Turkey demonstrate customer satisfaction. Our service values are expert knowledge and skills, trust, product quality, developing innovations and delivering excellent after-sales service. Mezbaha Teknolojileri experience provides machinery and equipment to meet the specific national, regional and local requirements of large and small meat processing companies. We provide turnkey solutions at the level of automation.

Effective solutions for Customer Satisfaction

Mezbaha Teknolojileri offers the most modern slaughter and meat processing systems, as well as cold room systems for cattle and sheep, combining them with automation technology. Meeting high standards, our company places great importance on animal welfare, quality, safety, hygiene and ergonomics.

Our efficiency guarantees the competitiveness of our customers: the intensive feedback we receive from customers using innovative systems helps us develop the latest scientific technologies.

Leadership across Turkey

Mezbaha Teknolojileri is a leader in abattoir automation systems.
